summary: Recents history is persisted to Room storage but is never retrieved or presented in the application UI.
claim: Recents history is persisted to Room storage but is never retrieved or presented in the application UI.

evidence.source: In app/src/main/kotlin/net/jamesjennison/spoolio/data/Databases.kt, UserDao exposes recents(): Flow<List<Recent>>. MainViewModel.kt inserts records into recents in select(), but never queries or exposes store.user.user().recents() to MainActivity.kt.

suggested_remediation: Expose the recents Flow from MainViewModel and add a Recents list section to the UI in MainActivity.kt allowing immediate re-selection and editing of recently accessed items.
suggested_validation: Select three distinct catalog and custom items, restart the app, and confirm that the main view renders the three recent items and allows selecting them for NFC write intent preparation.
